data.body: Investigation note (debug-everything 2026-05-11): Confirmed source-grepping anti-pattern across 9 test files. This is a multi-day refactoring effort — not appropriate for a hotfix in the current debug-everything session. The re-pin in d5cb-c871 makes the tests work today but creates a change-detector treadmill. Recommend scheduling a dedicated sprint to convert each grep/awk-against-MERGE_SCRIPT assertion to an execution-based behavioral test.
